mainEntity.name: How much does AI Overview optimization cost for businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI Overview optimization varies widely based on factors such as website size, current content quality, existing technical SEO, and the scope of services required. Small businesses with minor adjustments might incur lower costs than large enterprises needing extensive content audits and restructuring. Pricing can range from project-based fees for specific audits to ongoing monthly retainers for comprehensive strategy and implementation. Most agencies offer custom quotes after an initial assessment.
